note: New campground (opened 2024) on a 15-acre pit lake just off I-80 Exit 300 at Wood River: a row of concrete back-in pads on the lake side of the campground road, 21 with electric (2 ADA), plus 2 non-electric tent sites. Register at the self-service box at the entrance (cash or check). No-wake boating and fishing. --Claude
summary: NGPC's own pages are Cloudflare-blocked; its saved 2025 rates grid shows Cheyenne first-come only (no reservations asterisk) with Electric Plus and Basic sites, and an NGPC-relayed news item confirms 21 x 50-amp sites plus 2 tent sites. Fees re-based 10-15 -> 25-30 (every RV site is Electric Plus; the basic sites are tent sites), electric add-on cleared. Phone 308-385-6211 to add. Pin ~350 m off, on the entrance junction: move proposed. Waterfront lead UP (lakeview -> lakefront): the pads back onto the lake across 10-25 m of open grass.
flags: PHONE missing: add 308-385-6211 (NGPC rates grid row 'Cheyenne SRA SW 308-385-6211'; the same number in a search summary of the park page).

PIN (move proposed): stored 40.76550,-98.58820 is the junction of the entrance road and the Wood River I-80 exit road (Hwy 11), at the NE end of the campground. Google's 2026 imagery shows the 2024 pad row running ~550 m SW along the lake's north side from ~40.7651,-98.5889 to ~40.7627,-98.5946; its middle is ~40.7639,-98.5918, ~350 m from the pin. Suggest 40.7639,-98.5918. (NAIP and Esri imagery predate the campground and show no pads.)

WATERFRONT LEAD (up, lakeview -> lakefront): on Google's 2026 z19 imagery the campground road runs along the field edge on the NORTH side and every pad in the row backs south-east toward the lake. The pad ends sit ~8-25 m from the waterline (measured on 0.23 m/px tiles: e.g. ~16 m and ~20 m on the eastern pads, ~8 m, ~19 m and ~20 m on the western ones), across mown/brushy open ground with scattered single trees and shrubs on the bank; no road, driveway or day-use area lies between pads and water. One small building (vault toilet or shelter, ~40.7650,-98.5904) sits behind one eastern pad, and the few pads around the NE turnaround by the entrance are ~80-100 m from the water. Lake measured at ~14.7 acres by flood-fill (stored note: 15 acres) - well above the 5-acre pond line. The stored 'lakeview' evidence is only a pointer to commit 3126a2b (2026-06 sweep), probably made on pre-campground imagery. No official campsite photo or map read (NGPC pages blocked).
